'''Operation End Game''' was a joint mission of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]], [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that was conducted during the [[Galactic War]]. Its goal was to destroy the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] new warship, the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'' under the command of [[Darth Karrid]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. SIS [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] were sent out as the forefront of the operation which was under the direct command of [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] and [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS Director]] [[Marcus Trant]]. The mission was successful and the ''Ascendant Spear'' was destroyed and Darth Karrid killed.
